verdict.rationale: Featurebase ships an official typed JavaScript SDK (featurebase-js) with install guides, a React helper that manages the lifecycle, and framework integration guidance, and its developer docs point to a full SDK reference. The documented SDK is scoped to the Messenger client, and no server-side or multi-language SDKs for the REST API are evidenced. missing for 10: evidence of server-side SDKs or SDKs in languages beyond JavaScript covering the REST API (feedback, help center, reports), independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Typed client SDK for the Featurebase Messen
`featurebase-js/react` is an optional helper that handles the boot / update / shutdown lifecycle for you and exposes the messenger's reactive state via a hook.
Install, boot, and start chatting with users in four lines.
Looking for the full HTTP and SDK reference? Switch to the API Reference tab in the top navigation.
